records.source: A fourth, :class:`HostedProvider`, needs no CLI and no account: it asks spaCR's relay, which answers with a free hosted model, and it is the default when none of the three is installed and signed in (:func:`default_provider`).
records.context: A fourth, :class:`HostedProvider`, needs no CLI and no account: it asks spaCR's relay, which answers with a free hosted model, and it is the default when none of the three is installed and signed in (:func:`default_provider`).

records.label: spacr.qt.ai.providers.HostedProvider#1
records.source: It sends only what :func:`_hosted_request` keeps, the anonymised error summary and the question, to the relay's ``/diagnose`` route through :func:`spacr.crashreport.diagnose_remotely`. The answer is generated advice and is labelled as such. It is the provider used when no vendor CLI is installed and signed in (:func:`default_provider`), and it is unavailable when the network is forbidden (:func:`spacr.crashreport.network_allowed`).
records.context: It sends only what :func:`_hosted_request` keeps, the anonymised error summary and the question, to the relay's ``/diagnose`` route through :func:`spacr.crashreport.diagnose_remotely`. The answer is generated advice and is labelled as such. It is the provider used when no vendor CLI is installed and signed in (:func:`default_provider`), and it is unavailable when the network is forbidden (:func:`spacr.crashreport.network_allowed`).
records.translation: 它仅将 :func:`_hosted_request` 保留的匿名化错误摘要和问题，发送到中继服务的 ``/diagnose`` 路径，使用 :func:`spacr.crashreport.diagnose_remotely` 进行发送。答复是生成的建议，并会标明这一点。当没有任何供应商 CLI 同时满足已安装且已登录时，就使用此提供方（:func:`default_provider`）；禁止联网时，它不可用（:func:`spacr.crashreport.network_allowed`）。
records.review_basis: Authored from exact current English and normal API context; independently technically reviewed by Hard; no human or native-speaker signoff
